bankr prompt "Using the agenthub skill, long \$20 ETH 5x with a 5% stop"

# Positions, balance and limits

# Risk off

setup: Wallet must be a plain EOA that can sign messages and EIP-712 typed data (Veranta rejects smart-wallet signatures)
One-time: a gasless delegation signature and USDC approvals on Base, both guided by the skill
Execution costs $0.01 USDC per executed trade via x402 on Base; quotes and reads are free
